segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: Welcome everyone, I'm Ada Example and I'll host today's session.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: Let's start with the first question from the audience.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_01
segments.text: How long does the import job take for a large archive?

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: For a ten gigabyte archive it usually finishes in about 40 minutes on one worker.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_01
segments.text: And does it resume after a crash?

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: Yes, every stage writes a checkpoint, so it resumes where it stopped.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_02
segments.text: Will there be a mobile version next year?

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: Thanks everyone, that's all the time we have.
